_about: The empty idea spec (spec.json of out/blueprint/toolkit_plan.md section 3). `card` = the idea card, written before any run; `_card_lines` says which line of phase 0 each field answers. `run` = the settings, in the format of run_idea.py (its markets, bar sizes and sessions come from the card's home and neighbors, its name and reason from `name` and `why`); `exits` stays "standard" (line 0.2) and `filters` holds at most 2 (line 0.2). `main_setting` names the key of `run.params` that carries the 3-4 values (line 0.5). `sides` = "both" | "long" | "short".
